Definition: from a compound of G4253 and G5346; a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet:--prophet.
BiblicalUsage: Prophetes is the prophet, the foreteller, the inspired speaker, and the Bible is full of him from Moses to Malachi. Jesus says the prophets were persecuted before his disciples, Luke says he expounded all the prophets to the men on the road, and Peter says the prophets enquired and searched diligently into the salvation they foretold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the prophets are the spine of Scripture: they spoke God's word before it happened, and their words still judge and comfort us. Christ himself is the Prophet Moses promised, and every prophet before him was pointing his way.
